Subject: QuantumMed — trial support package request

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — enjoyed the discussion about ML inference latency targets for your imaging pipeline. As we discussed, QuantumMed is at the end of the 30-day trial and your usage trend looks promising (attached usage CSV).

Request: QuantumMed has asked for an additional 6-week trial window plus a one-time consumption credit to help them complete an on-site benchmark and procurement review. Specifically they’ve requested: 
- 6-week extension to the trial start date
- $10,000 consumption credits applied to the sandbox environment
- A short-term 20% introductory discount on the first paid month if they convert within 90 days

I’ve attached a short request packet (Quantummed_MO-package_request.pdf) and the latest trial_usage_report.csv for context. Procurement is targeting a PO by 2027-01-10 and they’ve asked for the commercial terms to be confirmed before then.

Can you confirm whether we can approve the full package as an exception? If approvals are required, please loop in the usual stakeholders — sales ops and finance. I’m happy to pull together a one-page mutual action plan if helpful.

Thanks,

— Olga

Team — forwarding the thread and the request packet from QuantumMed. They’ve tied the trial extension and a one-time credit to an imminent procurement decision; PO target 2027-01-10.

Ask: can we approve a one-off support package that includes the 6-week extension and up to $10k in consumption credits? Additional ask is a 20% first-month intro discount if they convert within 90 days. My suggested guardrails:
- Credits capped at $10k and expire 90 days after issuance
- Intro discount only redeemable on their first paid invoice, not combinable with any reserved commitment credits
- Require a signed mutual action plan (MAP) and an intended conversion date to trigger credits

Commercial notes: they’re a strategic healthcare win (imaging) and the reference value is high for our roadmap. We could pair approval with a short-term case study clause.

Attachments: Quantummed_MO-package_request.pdf, trial_usage_report.csv

Would appreciate quick guidance — Procurement wants confirmation before 2027-01-06. If helpful I can draft the approval language for finance/legal.

— Olga

Approved with conditions — happy to sign off on the full package to keep momentum with QuantumMed. Conditions: 
1) Credits: authorize $10,000 consumption credit to be applied to their sandbox/project namespace; credit expires 90 days after issuance.
2) MAP: require a signed mutual action plan within 14 days of credits being granted, outlining conversion target and PoC acceptance criteria.
3) Conversion incentive: the 20% introductory discount is allowed but only on the first monthly invoice and not combinable with any reserved or committed discounts.
4) Case study: customer must approve a short anonymized performance vignette for GTM use; opt-out allowed but reduce approved credits to $8,000 if they decline.

Aditya — please confirm accounting/ledger treatment and whether we need to log this as a sales credit memo against QM-2026-1125. Marissa — please push final wording into the MAP and I’ll sign.
